purpose: Integrate private Capture memory with Context Foundry without creating a second authority system.
principles: COMPACTION MUST PRESERVE SOURCE IDS AND REVISIONS
WATERMARK ADVANCES ONLY AFTER DURABLE SUMMARY WRITE
OLD RAW MATERIAL REMAINS REOPENABLE SUBJECT TO RETENTION/PRIVACY
PATENT FREEZES A MEMORY SNAPSHOT; LATER MEMORY CHANGES DO NOT MUTATE IT

context_foundry_projection.rule: Only selected context participates. Explicit IDs do not bypass privacy.

hot_warm_cold_books.rule: Books are relevance/selection tiers and pointers, not a substitute for the private raw Capture store. P4 may add pointers to active Capture memory sources; it must not dump private literals into GitHub HOT/WARM/COLD files.

recent_exact.stores: exact current eligible transcript revisions, not summaries

eligibility.unconfirmed_policy: May remain recent literal context but must be labeled UNCONFIRMED_TRANSCRIPT.

rolling_summary.privacy: strongest covered source privacy unless valid declassification exists
forbidden: dropping unresolved contradiction because it is inconvenient
covering a source revision without recording its identity
weakening privacy without a trusted export/declassification receipt

compaction.trigger: An eleventh eligible literal exists for the same semantic page/context, or an accepted Work Item explicitly requests metabolism.
transaction: Read current recent_exact, rolling_summary and watermark under revision/CAS guard.
Choose the oldest eligible literal not already covered.
Build a new rolling summary that includes that source revision and prior summary lineage.
Persist summary revision and covered source set.
Advance watermark only if the summary write succeeds and source set matches.
Recompute recent_exact so it contains the newest ten eligible literals.
compaction.idempotence: A covered capture revision cannot be summarized twice into the same lineage branch.
compaction.failure_rule: If any write fails, the previous watermark/recent window remains authoritative. Never advance watermark first.

work_item_metabolism.accepted_or_integrated: May mark covered intent METABOLIZED and compact it according to policy.
work_item_metabolism.rejected: Keep intent/history as unresolved or negative knowledge; do not summarize it as completed work.
work_item_metabolism.new_followup_capture: Creates new current intent even when an older related Work Item is integrated.

contains: negative knowledge/open questions needed by scope
patent_memory_snapshot.freezing_rule: Patent read always returns creation-time memory snapshot. Later edits, compaction or Current movement never mutate the stored Patent snapshot.
patent_memory_snapshot.export_rule: Every included LOCAL-derived field must be covered by the Patent export/declassification decision.

required_changes: Add/derive exact capture revision references rather than capture IDs alone.
Add source digests and watermark/CAS semantics.
Do not treat this row as canonical Current/Human Accepted truth.
